# dsh-web-search-serper
English | 中文
## Overview
`@dingpenghui/dsh-web-search-serper` is a web search provider plugin backed by the Serper.dev API, f
or the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web capability seam (`ctx.web`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web` `0.2.0-rc.x`).
It is built and verified against DSH **0.2.0-rc.2** and **0.2.1-rc.2**.
Serper.dev is an official Google Search partner providing fast, structured Google search results API
. Free tier: **2,500 queries per month**, no credit card required.
### Features

- 🚀 **Fast Search** — 1-2 second response times using Google's real index
- 📊 **Structured Results**

— JSON format, easy to parse
- 🔒 **Privacy Friendly** — No user tracking, no cookie collection
- 💰

**Generous Free Tier** — 2,500 monthly queries at no cost
- 🌍 **Multi-language Support** — Results f

rom countries/regions worldwide
- 🔧 **Works Right After Install** — the plugin claims `web.searchPro
vider` at runtime, so **no config edits and no restart** are needed; key resolved lazily per search

(config → env → credential store), also without a restart
- 🛟 **Automatic Fallback** — when Serper i
s unavailable it hands the request to another usable search provider instead of breaking `web_search

` entirely
- ⚙️ **Settings Page on the Plugins Page** — the plugin's own page (opened from its name
in the Plugins list, or from the row's configure control) edits the API key; saved values apply to t

he next search without a restart. **That is the only setting** — retrieval itself needs no tuning
-
🔁 **Hot Configuration** — every search re-reads the row config (including `volatile()`-wrapped value
s from `ctx.settings.describe()`), so credentials and options changed elsewhere are picked up immedi
m `ctx.settings.describe()`), so credentials and options changed elsewhere are picked up immediately

while running does nothing; (4) in
> every one of those cases search quietly kept using the built-i

n backend with
> no error at all. Runtime takeover removes all four.

### Compatibility

Since `1.2.3`, the DSH compatibility range is expressed **solely** by
`engines.dsh` (`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <

0.3.0-0`), and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web` /
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` are **not** listed in `peerDependenci

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web` /
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` are **not** listed in `peerDependencies`. See below.

**Why `1.1.1` refuses to install:** without `engines.dsh`, DSH's install gate
(`evaluatePluginCompat

ibility` in `dsh-app-boot`) inspects every
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` entry of `peerDependencies` and eval

uates it with
`semver.satisfies(runtime, range, { includePrerelease: true })`. `1.1.1` pinned
`@deep

seek-ai/dsh-web` to the exact version `0.2.0-rc.2`, and under that rule
`0.2.1-rc.2` does **not** sa
tisfy `0.2.0-rc.2`, so the install is rejected:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`1.2.3` lets `engines.dsh` decide alone (when present, the host looks at it and
ignores peers) and d

rops the peer declarations for host-provided DSH runtime
packages, which a plugin must not vendor a

second copy of. `smoke-test.mjs`
gained a regression guard that calls the host's own
`evaluatePlugin

Compatibility` when available (falling back to an equivalent
local implementation), so the manifest

must stay installable on `0.2.0-rc.2`
and `0.2.1-rc.2` and rejected on `0.3.0` / `0.1.5`.

The slot/page surface is unchanged from `1.2.2`: `plugins.bundle.config`
receives only `view: 'page'

` (no `form`, so it renders a read-only overview),
while `plugins.row.config` receives the row's `fo

rm` (`state` + `mutate`) and is
the editable view; both follow `configForms.whileServed`.

> declares the surface

it consumes in `src/contracts.d.ts` and
> `src/client/*.d.ts` to keep types stable across runtime l

onsumes in `src/contracts.d.ts` and
> `src/client/*.d.ts` to keep types stable across runtime lines.
## Limitations & Known Issues

1. **Free tier limit** — 2,500 monthly queries, paid plans for higher usage
2. **Google Search only*

* — Does not support Bing, Baidu, or other search engines
3. **No generated answers** — Returns sear

ch results only, no AI-generated summaries
4. **API Key required** — Must provide a valid Serper API

Key via config, environment, or credential reference
5. **One DSH line at a time** — `1.2.3` suppor
ts DSH `0.2.x` (`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`); a different runtime line needs the matching plugin version
(see "Compatibility")
